_doc: Tuning numbers for the rules, kept in one place for balancing. Percentages are whole numbers (25 = +25%). M3 adds abyss, exposure, crypto, market, ark and victories.

crypto._doc: Crypto per cycle from each settlement you hold.

abyss._doc: Abyssians (design bible sections 9 and 13). From firstRise, every open rift with prey in reach gains pressure each cycle (1, plus 1 per rampEvery cycles); at riseAt it spawns an Abyssian picked by weight from those whose 'from' cycle has come, if fewer than capBase + capPerRift are alive. Abyssians hunt the nearest settlement within huntRadius of their rift, smash its walls, ravage it (city loses a stage; you lose ravageStealPct of your Matter and Compute, and half the progress on that settlement's build and on the Ark), then go back to sink into their rift. kaijuHidePct = UPow change for a non-titan fighting a kaiju. Rift hearts heal heartHealPerCycle and defend with heartUpow[tier]; the Mother grows motherGrowthPct UPow each time she retreats.

exposure._doc: Exposure: how much the world knows about you (design bible section 6). Levels at 25 Noticed, 50 Revealed (permanent: never drops below 50 again), 75 Hunted, 100 Crusade (every faction declares war on you and they make peace with each other; no faction will make peace with you while it lasts). attitude = shift in where faction opinion drifts, per level. natives = UPow % for faction units fighting you, per level. Gains are in Exposure points; the Exposure effect (Cover Stories, the Inevitable doctrine) scales every gain. scrub = Crypto to wipe scrubAmount, once a cycle.

market._doc: Black market (Crypto). Each offer can be taken once a cycle.

ark._doc: Exodus: build the Ark in three stages at one of your Nodes, then leave. Each stage spends its cost up front, then holds energy Energy for its cycles (brownout halves progress).

stages.name: Keel
stages.blurb: A hull the length of a city, laid down in secret.

stages.name: Drive
stages.blurb: An engine that will only ever be lit once.

stages.name: Ascent
stages.blurb: Fuel, shielding and a living hull that heals in vacuum. Then you leave.

victories._doc: Homeworld victories (design bible section 9). Each can be played past. doctrine = the victory each doctrine's OBJECTIVE points at; any victory counts. Assimilation needs at least one surviving faction, all of them at devoted opinion or better.
